scope.summary: Implement the erection continuum (spec 13.21; REQ-032, SOS pattern, GREQ-034): flaccid-to-erect as a single 0..1 pose+morph composite (bone-chain arc plus engorgement girth, glans/vein prominence, scrotum tightening) with a rigid/floppy per-scene state machine switching between posed and physics-driven behavior, exportable as both pose asset and baked blendshape.
acceptance_criteria: erection channel 0..1 drives one composite: bone-chain pose (angle/arc) plus morphs (engorgement girth, glans/vein prominence, scrotum tightening); every intermediate state (semi-erect) is valid and renderable.

State machine: rigid (posed, animation-friendly) vs floppy (jiggle-chain physics active via MT-525/BkSoftTissue coupling) switchable per scene - the SOS rigid/floppy precedent; the switch is animation data, never a shader trick (GREQ-034).
Erection states export as both bone pose assets and baked blendshapes (REQ-032; consumed by MT-612) so the continuum survives FBX to UE/Blender.
The arousal controller (MT-559) may drive erection through an explicit, disable-able link edge.
scope.risk_if_missed: Rigid/floppy per-scene switching is the SOS-proven user expectation (GREQ-034); an erection that is only a morph or only a pose fails one of the two export consumers (REQ-032) and cannot be driven by game logic or scene state.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
